description_en: Enables or disables the detection feature of a sensitive data detection rule
description_zh: 调用本接口开启或关闭敏感数据识别规则的检测功能
name: ModifyRuleStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The unique ID of the sensitive data detection rule.

To enable or disable the detection feature of a sensitive data detection rule, you must specify the unique ID of the rule. You can call the DescribeRules operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
敏感数据识别规则的唯一标识ID。

开启或关闭敏感数据识别规则的检测功能，需要提供敏感数据识别规则的唯一标识ID。可调用DescribeRules接口获取该ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en:
The unique IDs of the sensitive data detection rules. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
To enable or disable the detection feature of a sensitive data detection rule, you must specify the unique ID of the rule. You can call the DescribeRules operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
敏感数据识别规则的唯一标识ID。多个ID用半角逗号隔开。
开启或关闭敏感数据识别规则的检测功能，需要提供敏感数据识别规则的唯一标识ID，可调用DescribeRules接口获取该ID
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the detection feature of the sensitive data detection rule. Valid values:
0: disabled.  
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭敏感数据识别规则的检测功能。取值：
0：关闭。  
1：开启
parameters.name: status

FailedIds.description_en: The IDs of the rules whose status failed to be updated. Multiple IDs are separated by commas (,)
FailedIds.description_zh: 修改状态失败的规则ID集合。多个ID用半角逗号隔开
